senses.gloss:
शोष शोष, i. e. शुष् + अ, m.
 1. Drying up, Pañc. 51, 5; 159, 15.
 2. Exsiccation, ib. 76, 11.
 3. Pulmonary consumption.
 --Comp.

शोषण शोषण, i. e. शुष् + अन,
 I. adj. Drying up, causing to fade, Śāk. d. 58.
 II. m. One of the arrows of Kāma, Lass. 7, 3.
 III. n. Drying up, Lass. 2. ed. 91, 61; Pañc. 27, 1 (वृथा-शरीर-, Useless mortifying one's self).
ऽशोषिन् -शोषिन्, i. e. शुष् + इन्, Drying up, in हृदय-कुसुम-, adj. Causing (her) flower-like heart to fade, Utt. Rāmac. 53, 16.
